name: plc-tia
description: Generate and manipulate Siemens TIA Portal projects via the Openness API: connect/read/export, clone hardware devices, create tags, wire FBs, and import standard + safety (F) block chains. v1.5 ships TiaSharp, a C# (.NET 4.8) console tool with all recipes as dry-run/confirm subcommands, a persistent attach-once shell, and Notepad 'order' notes; the v1.0 PowerShell scripts remain as reference in the skills. All commands proven live on a real V17 project.
author: plc-tia
